'''Zygerrian''' was a [[Language/Legends|language]] spoken by the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was widely spoken among the Zygerrians stationed on the outpost [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kowak/Legends|Kowak]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Friends Like These" />
